statusDefinitions.known_failure: The current v3 path reproduces an incorrect or non-terminal outcome.
statusDefinitions.coverage_gap: The required v4 behavior has no complete executable receipt yet.
statusDefinitions.target_pass: Reserved for a future reviewed v4 receipt; M0 contains no target passes.

cases.reproduction: cd example && dart run lib/g3_headless_probe.dart --lib <release dylib>
cases.targetOutcome: The staged paste commits atomically, exact source remains available, and bounded pumps either certify the current revision or return a typed terminal reason before the declared pump and wall-time caps.

cases.initialSource:
*hello* rest of line.

Distant paragraph that the edit never touches.
cases.targetOutcome: The edited emphasis range is neutral pending at the new revision while the untouched distant paragraph remains certified for that revision.
The definition and every dependent reference are pending until recertified; the unrelated distant paragraph remains certified.
Open, edit, query, fragment layout, paint, and close remain within their explicit per-call and per-frame caps without whole-paragraph materialization.
The giant physical line is source-exact, incrementally editable, viewport-fragmented, and never copied or shaped in full on a foreground call.
Typing, splitting, merging, indenting, and outdenting around the continuation agree with a clean selected-profile parse after every step.

cases.reproduction: cd example && flutter run --profile -d macos -t lib/g2_jank_harness.dart
cases.targetOutcome: A stale or out-of-authority viewport request returns a discriminated retry, stale-revision, or source-gap result and never faults the session.
Every fault carries one stable machine discriminant, owning operation, revision, progress token, and bounded diagnostic detail.

cases.reproduction: continue editing after the G2 viewport fault
cases.targetOutcome: Closed is distinct from parser fault, host fault, cancellation, supersession, and completed resumable close.
Presentation wait always has live work, an observable dependency, or a typed terminal result; parked-without-progress is impossible.
A noncurrent session cannot report quiescent unless it also returns a typed blocked, cancelled, superseded, or faulted reason.
